# ClaudeMC v1.20.1 — startup crash fix (Minecraft 1.21.11)

Patch on top of the v1.20.0 1.21.11 migration. Fixes a hard startup crash
(carried over from the 1.21.1 line) caused by a GLFW call made before
Minecraft initializes GLFW.

## Bug fix

### Crash on launch: `GLFW error before init: [0x10001] The GLFW library is not initialized`
`onInitializeClient` runs **before** `RenderSystem.initBackendSystem()` calls
`glfwInit()`. The final startup log line resolved the GUI key name via
`KeybindManager.keyName()`, which calls the GLFW function `glfwGetKeyName()`.
Calling any GLFW function before `glfwInit()` raises `GLFW_NOT_INITIALIZED`,
which Minecraft's pre-init error callback turns into a fatal crash during
"Initializing game" — before the window even opens.

Fixes:
- The startup log no longer resolves the key name (it logs the raw keycode).
- `KeybindManager.keyName()` now only calls `glfwGetKeyName()` once the window
  exists (GLFW initialized), falling back to its static name table otherwise.

Everything from v1.20.0 (full 1.21.11 API migration, all modules, Companion
web app) is unchanged.
